note: One caption per entry. Each line is [kind, [[word, start seconds], ...]]: caps = the lead-in words, small Gotham Black capitals; ital = the words that matter, large serif bold italic (written here in the case they should appear). Optional: size = offer (larger) or big (the 40%); ink = dark for a light background; x, y = centre of the caption in the 1080 x 1920 frame; max = widest a line may be; cut = remove it at exactly this time with no fade (used where the shot it belongs to ends). The sofa shot runs 6.50 to 7.967 s, so its caption starts on the first frame of that shot and is gone on the last.
